license_activation.evidence: Ed25519 cryptographic challenge-response and activation protocol
license_activation.restrictions: Bound to approved evaluation license ID

device_binding.restrictions: Enforces max 2 devices per evaluation license

document_upload.evidence: MIME type, size limit (25MB), virus scanning mock, tenant isolation
document_upload.restrictions: PDF, DOCX, TXT, TIFF only; prohibited executables rejected

document_parsing.evidence: PyMuPDF / text extractors with clean fallback and error boundaries
document_parsing.restrictions: Encrypted or corrupted documents yield actionable error

document_intelligence.evidence: Grounded citation extraction and hallucination avoidance
document_intelligence.restrictions: LLM calls server-side only; evaluation data excluded from model training

context_optimization.evidence: Hierarchical chunking and BM25/Vector hybrid retrieval
context_optimization.restrictions: Tenant boundary enforced in vector store index

retrieval.evidence: Strict tenant-filtered similarity search and score normalization

comparison.evidence: Multi-document diffing with strict authorization check on all inputs
comparison.restrictions: Evaluator must own all documents being compared

export.evidence: Sanitized JSON and CSV export endpoints with rate limits

usage_reporting.evidence: Two-phase quota reservation and atomic counter reconciliation

license_revocation.evidence: Synchronous session blacklisting and token invalidation

evaluator_feedback.evidence: Categorized feedback intake with automated secret and payload redaction

evaluator_termination.evidence: Controlled offboarding cascading to document and embedding erasure
